messages:
maya: Quick heads up — HighGround POC is blocked. CISO pushed back: they need BYO KMS details, an SSO SAML test plan, and latency numbers under load before legal will sign. Can we get an exec bridge today? :frowning:
andre: On it. Who from infra/eng can join? I can start a writeup of the KMS flow (BYO key wrapping, policies, key rotation notes).
kira: I can run a quick perf profile against their worst-case payloads. Do we have the sample trace they sent?
maya: attaching their sample payload in the doc we shared. Also they asked for a 95th pct latency at 2k concurrent sessions.
jordan: For reserved capacity pricing — they asked for a 6 mo committed discount comp. Need to know what level of Dedicated we can promise for canary/production.
beth: Legal needs the KMS attestation text (customer-managed key flow + audit logs). I'll draft a clause but need the engineering description to avoid hand-wavy language.
andre: Draft KMS flow: customer uploads public wrapping key to our KMS config endpoint, we encrypt model keys wrapped by customer key, key rotation is customer-triggered via API, we log wrap/un-wrap ops to audit log. (will flesh into a diagram)
kira: For perf: I'll run a 10k token end-to-end with 2k concurrent sessions on a Dedicated-like instance locally and post p50/p95/p99. ETA 2 hours.
maya: Can we also prepare a fallback plan? They want automatic fallback to a smaller model if Dedicated throughput can't hit 2k concurrency.
jordan: Pricing note: if we guarantee reserved capacity at that concurrency, margin gets thin. Propose: 6-mo 20% discount on committed baseline + burst pricing for spikes. I'll draft a spreadsheet.
andre: @kira @beth once perf numbers are in I'll write the KMS wording for legal. Also need to confirm HSM/KMS provider names for their procurement.
beth: Also need SOC2 cert copy and penetration test report; ops should confirm the latest report link.
sam (deploy-bot): Deploy queued: canary-resize-test -> infra-lab-3; estimated completion in 25m.
kira: ran first pass: p50 40ms, p95 210ms, p99 480ms on toy rig — not a Dedicated equivalent but gives a baseline. Uploading raw logs.
maya: Good. Can someone compile a 1-pager for the exec bridge: "ask", "what we own", "what customer owns", "risks & mitigations", and proposed timeline?
andre: I'll take the KMS + runbook sections. jordan take pricing. kira metrics. maya you can own the customer communications.
jordan: Drafting pricing one-pager now. Quick ask: do we have an internal precedent discount doc? I want to avoid manual approvals.
beth: Legal can fast-review if engineering language is explicit. Send me the draft and I'll triage with procurement counsel.
maya: We have an exec availability window at 3pm PT. Can we run a 3:15pm bridge (30m) with CTO/EM and HighGround CISO + our legal & SEs?
and...
